default_bundle.note: Pulled on every fresh clone so Voxoryl works immediately. Hardware advisor may suggest upgrade/downgrade after. Fast = greetings/chitchat; chat = main brain.

tiers.label: Lite (weak GPU / low RAM)
tiers.reason: Prefer a tiny chat model so the machine stays responsive. Skip vision if VRAM is tiny.

tiers.label: Balanced (default clone target)
tiers.reason: Sweet spot for ~6GB laptop GPUs (e.g. GTX 1660 Ti) + 16GB RAM.

tiers.label: Strong (8–12GB VRAM)
tiers.reason: Room for a sharper daily driver without thrashing.

tiers.label: Beast (16GB+ VRAM)
tiers.reason: High-end local box — bigger weights are usable if you keep context modest.

cpu_only_fallback.reason: No usable GPU VRAM detected — stay tiny and CPU-friendly.
